tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because predict referenced train_rows outside its scope. The revised code fits the three-parameter static siphon model and correctly keeps fitted parameters for prediction; the observed monotone-concave response and gradient contrast support this model. Fresh confirmation remains necessary to establish whether its RMSE meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire extra_fine_trajectory_batch for coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All available observations share H=0.6 and mem_conv=0, and the observed signatures and input-response curve support a static monotone-concave response rather than dynamic memory.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit node Q cooperative Hill inhibition or node R barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Those four-parameter families are not uniquely supported by the current seven rows; the observed concave trend and signed sqrt branch are explained by the lower-complexity inland-hub siphon family.
The open-branch probe already varied sink gradient substantially; its pair of readings constrains the inhibition term, so further measurement is not justified before trying a numerical fit.
